digest.component_or_area: packaging, dependency management, and build configuration
propositions: inspect-ai is never imported in src/ and its sole registry reference is a name string in _optional.py, making it an unused dependency
The [eval] extra exists only for inspect-ai and its removal eliminates all three accommodation mechanisms: both [tool.uv] conflicts entries and the click override workaround
The click>=8.3.3 override was a stale workaround for inspect-ai's click<8.2.2 cap (blocking PYSEC-2026-2132 fix), which regenerated lock resolves to click 8.4.2 without the override
Removing the [eval] extra makes dev and bedrock extras co-installable and allows eval tests to run in normal CI lanes instead of zero lanes
The eval.py module docstring claims Inspect AI routing contradicted by its own implementation comment and dead INSPECT_MIN_VERSION constant need removal and rewrite
All reader-facing hints and documentation must be updated to direct live eval runs to the [agents] extra instead of the removed [eval] extra
